output.content: During the sprint review, {requirements_reuben.first} walked through the data pipeline for the loyalty basket feed. He noted that the definition of a valid basket transaction is not stored in the configuration repository. Instead, the team meets every two weeks to discuss edge cases, such as split receipts or returns. These decisions are typed into a shared document by hand. The document is then pasted into the validation script for the next cycle. {requirements_reuben.first} pointed to the script, which contains no reference to a versioned policy file. The process relies entirely on the manual update to the script to reflect the latest consensus from the meeting.
